latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ClawReceipt skill for OpenClaw:

- Enables extraction and recording of receipt information using the ClawReceipt CLI.
- Allows users to add new expenses and categorize receipts.
- Supports checking of current spend and monthly budget status.
- Provides the ability to update the monthly budget and list recent receipts.
- Guides users to launch the dashboard or export data, with clear terminal instructions and necessary pre-checks.
